status: submitted full-scene action brief; production instructions only

character.identity: First Counter, adult ledger-man; reference costume/cap, face, beard, proportions remain provisional draft reference. Do not conflate him with later thin man or Vale.
character.pose: Seated on stump, torso weighted over ledger, gaze fixed downward. Writing hand appears screen-left; preserve source handedness. Opposite hand supports open book.
character.action: Actual connected writing, lift, return, landing, second-line writing, finish. Finger/wrist articulation drives nib; shoulder/forearm subtly support movement without body distortion.
replacement_requirements: Individually controlled key drawings against the same clean plate and ledger plane, with complete wrist, cuff, fingers and feather silhouette.
For each active three-frame slot, supply registered meaningful movement rather than stretching exposure of four poses.
Connected release/rise/apex/return/descent/landing drawings; no sudden return pop.
Separate second-line articulation drawn at the correct paper depth; do not shift entire first-line cutout bank.
No final pose atlas accepted as motion; inspect neighboring registered drawings and then decoded shot.

props.ledger: Rigid open leather ledger supported across knee, same page perspective and spine throughout each view; no page turn.
props.quill: Stable feather/shaft construction, grip and nib relationship. Shaft may rotate as a rigid element only while grip contact remains plausible; hand needs corresponding replacement drawing.
props.ink: Exactly two new rows of nonverbal varied handwriting marks, with variable lengths/gaps. Reveal only behind contacting nib. Do not invent readable dialogue or words. Existing background page texture must not masquerade as newly written third line.
props.page_paths: Layout defines a safe writing surface in page-local coordinates, inset from gutter and fore-edge. First line and lower second line share perspective. Endpoints require layout verification; this script brief does not assert unmeasured pixel coordinates.
locks: No pen/page penetration or floating contact during writing
Complete feather outline in each cel

environment.setting: Dark mangrove bank, seated stump, root/water background from exact reference.
environment.action: Localized independent torch flame and restrained warm light modulation; maintain stable roots, waterline and actor palette. No camera motion substituted for writing.
environment.geometry: Torch holder and tree rigid; isolate flame/light from painted background.

effects.treatment: Preserve broad cel shading; localized flame/light effects on separate layers, no global flashing wash or mesh-warped painting.

camera.insert: Proposed hard cut at frame 18 to locked pen/page CU, held through frame 167. Cut timing is a draft staging proposal; script authorizes insert but gives no exact cut frame.
camera.layout_dependency: Inspect native page resolution and contour separation. If enlarged crop cannot show coherent nib contact, draw a controlled dedicated CU plate and matching hand keys. Do not upscale an unusable shallow paper slice and call it resolved.
camera.prohibition: No pan/zoom to imply writing; no continuing camera movement through contact scrutiny.

layout: Register medium-shot and close-up views with fixed ledger/paper geometry and cuff-root anchor.
Save safe writing bounds, first/second line paths and nib-contact coordinates for each planned key.
Determine occlusion order of hand/quill/page and clean plate coverage before requesting drawings.
key_animation: Produce individual contact-matched keys for each line start/end, release, apex, descent/landing and final settle.
Use one controlled drawing need per image-demand turn with actual registered plate references when missing; repeated broad sheets have failed.
inbetween: Fill active three-frame slots with consistent fingers/wrist/cuff/quill drawings; source artwork insufficiency is a drawing blocker.
Verify small intentional neighboring nib changes and curved lift path, not just numeric cadence.
cleanup_paint: Preserve true ink contour mattes, no polygon clipping, sleeve rectangles, feather cuts or atlas contamination.
Preserve source palette and fixed torso; independently compositable drawing layers.
compositing: Separate clean plate, changing arm/cuff, quill if separately rigid, ink, flame and light.
Use Craft editable project and exposure records; retain source drawings/hashes; render silent168f24fps16:9 draft.
review: Inspect native-size contacts at start/mid/end of both lines and every lift/landing transition.
Play full shot and adjacent cuts; decode/exposure arithmetic alone cannot prove motion.
Compare all prior F1-F4 failures and confirm no repeat.

remaining_dependencies: Valid layout and clean contact plate
Controlled keys and connected breakdown drawings
